items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an LoadbalanceRSocketClient that will connect to one of the given targets selected through the given LoadbalanceRSocketClient.
items.translation: 构建一个带有 `LoadbalanceRSocketClient` 的 RSocketRequester，该客户端将通过给定的 `LoadbalanceRSocketClient` 连接到给定目标中的一个。

items.source: in favor of transport(ClientTransport)
items.translation: 支持transport(ClientTransport)。

items.source: in favor of tcp(String, int)
items.translation: 支持tcp(String, int)

items.source: in favor of websocket(URI)
items.translation: 支持使用websocket(URI)。

items.source: Allows further customization on RSocketStrategies, mutating them if they were set, or starting from RSocketStrategies.builder() defaults}.
items.translation: 允许对 `RSocketStrategies` 进行进一步的自定义，如果它们是通过 `set` 设置的，则对其进行修改；或者从 `RSocketStrategies.builder()` 的默认值开始。

items.source: This is useful for changing the default settings, yet still allowing further customizations via rsocketStrategies(Consumer). If not set, defaults are obtained from RSocketStrategies.builder().
items.translation: 这可用于更改默认设置，同时仍允许通过rsocketStrategies(Consumer)进行进一步自定义。如果未设置，则从RSocketStrategies.builder()获取默认值。

items.source: If not set, this will be initialized to the MimeType of the first non-default Decoder, or otherwise the MimeType of the first decoder.
items.translation: 如果未设置，将初始化为第一个`non-default` `Decoder` 的 MimeType，否则为第一个解码器的 MimeType。

items.source: By default this is set to "message/x.rsocket.composite-metadata.v0" in which case the route, if provided, is encoded as a "message/x.rsocket.routing.v0" composite metadata entry. If this is set to any other MimeType, it is assumed that's the MimeType for the route, if provided.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 `"message/x.rsocket.composite-metadata.v0"`，在这种情况下，如果提供了路由，则将其编码为 `"message/x.rsocket.routing.v0"` 复合元数据条目。如果将此值设置为任何其他 MimeType，则假设这是路由（如果提供）的 MimeType。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source:
Callback to configure the RSocketConnector directly.
  • The data and metadata mime types cannot be set directly on the RSocketConnector and will be overridden. Use the shortcuts dataMimeType(MimeType) and metadataMimeType(MimeType) on this builder instead.
  • The frame decoder also cannot be set directly and instead is set to match the configured DataBufferFactory.
  • For the setupPayload, consider using methods on this builder to specify the route, other metadata, and data as Object values to be encoded.
  • To configure client side responding, see RSocketMessageHandler.responder(RSocketStrategies, Object...).
items.translation:
回调以直接配置 RSocketConnector。
  • 无法直接在 RSocketConnector 上设置数据和元数据 MIME 类型，它们将被覆盖。请使用此构建器上的快捷方式 dataMimeType(MimeType) 和 metadataMimeType(MimeType)。
  • 帧解码器也无法直接设置，而是设置为与配置的 DataBufferFactory 匹配。
  • 对于 setupPayload，请考虑使用此构建器上的方法来指定路由、其他元数据和作为要编码的对象值的数据。
  • 要配置客户端响应，请参阅 RSocketMessageHandler.responder(RSocketStrategies, Object...)。

items.source: Add metadata entry to the setup payload. Composite metadata must be in use if this is called more than once or in addition to setupRoute(String, Object...). The metadata value be a concrete value or any producer of a single value that can be adapted to a Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: 向设置负载添加元数据条目。如果此方法被多次调用或与setupRoute(String, Object...)一起使用，则必须使用复合元数据。元数据值必须是一个具体值或任何能够生成单个值的对象，该值可以通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 适配为 Publisher。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an RSocketClient that connects over TCP to the given host and port.
items.translation: 构建一个带有 `RSocketClient` 的 `RSocketRequester`，该客户端通过 TCP 连接到指定的主机和端口。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an RSocketClient that connects over WebSocket to the given URL.
items.translation: 构建一个带有 `RSocketClient` 的 `RSocketRequester`，该客户端通过 WebSocket 连接到给定的 URL。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an RSocketClient that connects over TCP to the given host and port. The requester can be used to make requests concurrently. Requests are made over a shared connection that is also re-established as needed when further requests are made.
items.translation: 构建一个带有 `RSocketClient` 的 `RSocketRequester`，该客户端通过 TCP 连接到指定的主机和端口。请求器可用于并发发出请求。请求是通过共享连接进行的，当需要进一步发出请求时，该连接也会根据需要重新建立。

items.source: Build an RSocketRequester with an RSocketClient that connects over WebSocket to the given URL. The requester can be used to make requests concurrently. Requests are made over a shared connection that is also re-established as needed when further requests are made.
items.translation: 构建一个带有 `RSocketClient` 的 `RSocketRequester`，该客户端通过 WebSocket 连接到指定的 URL。请求器可用于并发发出请求。请求通过共享连接发出，当需要进一步发出请求时，该连接也会根据需要重新建立。
